# Getprospect

Find anyone's business email address. GetProspect provides email discovery and verification from LinkedIn.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/getprospect/.

## Actions

- **Add Contacts to List**: Add contacts to a specified list.
- **Create Company**: Create a new company.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact.
- **Create Contact List**: Create a new contact list.
- **Get account workspace limits** (read-only): Retrieve workspace limits for the user's account.
- **Get All Companies** (read-only): Retrieve all companies.
- **Get All Contact Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all prospect contact lists.
- **Get all contacts** (read-only): Retrieve all contacts.
- **Get Contact Lists Count** (read-only): Retrieve the total count of contact lists.
- **Get Single Company** (read-only): Retrieve details of a single company by its ID.
- **Get Single Contact** (read-only): Retrieve details of a single contact.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Search for companies by name.
- **Search Contacts** (read-only): Search for contacts by filters.
- **Search Contacts in List** (read-only): Search contacts in a specific list.
- **Search Lists by Name** (read-only): Search contact lists by name.
- **Update Company**: Update details of an existing company.
- **Update Contact**: Update details of an existing contact.
- **Update Contact List**: Update a contact list's name.
- **Verify Email Address** (read-only): Verify an email's deliverability.
- **Apply Coupon Code**: Apply a coupon code to the user's account.
- **Create Export**: Create a new export job.
- **Delete Company**: Delete a company record by its ID.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact record by its ID.
- **Delete Multiple Contact Lists**: Delete multiple contact lists.
